company: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited
about: Bombay Coated and Special Steels Limited is a steel processing centre engaged in converting steel coils into value-added processed steel products. It provides precision slitting, cut-to-length processing, shearing, and embossing services for OEMs and ODMs primarily in the home appliances, commercial appliances, and general engineering sectors. The company operates four manufacturing facilities located across Wada and Bhiwandi (Maharashtra), Ghiloth (Rajasthan), and Sri City (Andhra Pradesh).

objects.purpose: Repayment/pre-payment, in full or in part, of certain borrowings availed by our Company
Financing the cost towards acquisition of capital equipment under existing lease arrangements with Siemens Financial Services Private Limited

promoters.background: Mr. Vijaykumar Himatrai Gupta (Chairman & Whole Time Director) has over 40 years of steel industry experience, and Mr. Nitin Vijaykumar Gupta (Managing Director) has approximately 20 years of experience.

concentration.note: Top 10 customers accounted for 71.33% of revenue from operations in FY26. Company is heavily dependent on single supplier JSWSCPL for 86.65% of raw material purchases in FY26.

litigation_note: No contingent liabilities reported as of March 31, 2026; capital commitments stood at ₹2.04 crore as of March 31, 2026 and ₹9.83 crore as of June 30, 2026.
strengths: Authorised service partner relationship with JSW Steel Coated Products Limited ensuring consistent coil sourcing.
Long-standing relationships with leading OEM and ODM customers across consumer durables and home appliances sectors.
Strategically located manufacturing network across Maharashtra, Rajasthan, and Andhra Pradesh enabling just-in-time deliveries.
Comprehensive steel processing capabilities including slitting, cut-to-length, embossing, and shearing.
High entry barriers driven by partner accreditations, capital intensity, and strict customer approvals.
Experienced promoters with more than four decades of operating track record in the steel industry.

risks.title: Extreme supplier dependence on JSWSCPL
risks.detail: Company sourced 86.65% of its steel coil requirements from JSWSCPL in FY26 (90.61% in FY25), creating high concentration risk.

risks.title: Substantial indebtedness and debt service obligations
risks.detail: Total borrowings stood at ₹338.45 crore as of March 31, 2026 (₹302.43 crore as of August 31, 2026), with a debt-to-equity ratio of 2.78.

risks.title: Customer concentration risk
risks.detail: Top 10 customers contributed 71.33% of revenue in FY26 and 73.54% in Q1 FY27; loss of key customers would severely impact business.

risks.title: History of non-compliance and delayed RoC statutory filings
risks.detail: The company had multiple delays in filing statutory forms including CHG-1, ADT-1, CRA-2, DPT-3, and MGT-14 with the Registrar of Companies.

risks.title: Extensive related-party transactions and promoter unsecured loans
risks.detail: Significant borrowings and interest payments to promoters and relatives; outstanding borrowings from related parties stood at ₹22.34 crore as of March 31, 2026.

risks.title: Volatile operating cash flows
risks.detail: Net cash flow from operations decreased sharply from ₹32.09 crore in FY25 to ₹10.22 crore in FY26 due to working capital swings.

risks.title: Thin profit margins
risks.detail: The company operates on low net profit margins of 2.41% in FY26 and 2.72% in FY25, leaving little buffer against steel price fluctuations.

risks.title: Issue objects have not been independently appraised
risks.detail: Proposed deployment of ₹183.06 crore gross issue proceeds is based solely on internal management estimates without bank or agency appraisal.

notes: Financial figures for Q1 FY27 (ended June 30, 2026: Revenue ₹397.08 cr, PAT ₹15.08 cr, Net Worth ₹136.62 cr) have been excluded from 3-year arrays as per instructions.
